title: Calculation Sheet: Manufacturer Copay Card Counter Benefit (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The Manufacturer Copay Card benefit billed at the counter under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is worked out on this sheet.

**The claim.** The claim is the latest paid insurance claim of the card's prescription; its patient pay, its deductible and its date are read from that claim.

**The counter benefit.** The counter benefit on a claim is the claim's patient pay limited to the program's per-fill benefit maximum, less the program's patient minimum pay, and never more than the benefit dollars left on the program, rounded to the cent half up. In the working below, the claim's patient pay is the benefit base, the program's per-fill benefit maximum is the counter limit, and the program's patient minimum pay is the counter minimum pay.

**Order.** The benefit base is first limited to the counter limit; the counter minimum pay is then taken off; the result is finally held to the benefit dollars left on the program and never set below zero, rounded to the cent half up.

**Benefit dollars left.** The benefit dollars left on the program are the credits of its period-opening entries and benefit reversals less its benefit entries and closing entries.

The per-fill benefit maximum and the patient minimum pay are the program's figures on the benefit dollars schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: per-fill benefit maximum $800.00, patient minimum pay $5.00)

| Claim patient pay | Benefit dollars left | Counter benefit |
|---|---|---|
| $150.00 | $9600.00 | $145.00 |
| $2000.00 | $9600.00 | $795.00 |
| $2000.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |
| $4.00 | $9600.00 | $0.00 |
